## `Core/Animation/Easing.h`

- `constexpr float Clamp01(float t)` — Animation curves and time helpers.
- `constexpr float EaseLinear(float t)` — Constant speed.
- `constexpr float EaseInQuad(float t)` — Gentle versions of the cubic curves below.
- `constexpr float EaseOutQuad(float t)`
- `constexpr float EaseInOutQuad(float t)`
- `constexpr float EaseInCubic(float t)` — Starts slowly, finishes accelerating.
- `constexpr float EaseOutCubic(float t)` — Starts fast, stops smoothly.
- `constexpr float EaseInOutCubic(float t)` — Starts slowly, accelerates in the middle, finishes slowly.
- `constexpr float EaseInQuart(float t)` — Sharper versions of the cubic curves.
- `constexpr float EaseOutQuart(float t)`
- `constexpr float EaseInOutQuart(float t)`
- `inline float EaseInSine(float t)` — Softest of the smooth curves.
- `inline float EaseOutSine(float t)`
- `inline float EaseInOutSine(float t)`
- `inline float EaseInExpo(float t)` — Nearly still, then very fast; and the reverse.
- `inline float EaseOutExpo(float t)`
- `constexpr float EaseInBack(float t)` — Pulls back before leaving (wind-up).
- `constexpr float EaseOutBack(float t)` — Slightly overshoots the target and returns (pop-in).
- `constexpr float EaseInOutBack(float t)` — Pulls back, crosses over, overshoots and returns.
- `inline float EaseOutElastic(float t)` — Shivers around the target and settles there (a spring hit); the reverse for a shiver that builds up.
- `inline float EaseInElastic(float t)`
- `constexpr float EaseOutBounce(float t)` — Falls on the target and bounces a few times (a landing); the reverse for bounces that grow into the move.
- `constexpr float EaseInBounce(float t)`
- `constexpr float Progress01(float t, float from, float to)` — Time helpers for one or two moments: 't' (age) relative to them.
- `constexpr float Since(float t, float moment)` — Time since 'moment'; negative before it.
- `constexpr float EaseOutPulse(float t, float at, float seconds)` — Pulse peaking at 'at' and fading over 'seconds' (EaseOutCubic); 0 before it.
- `constexpr float Staggered(float t, float delay, float index, float step, float seconds)` — Staggered items: item 'index' starts at 'delay + index × step' and rises from 0 to 1 over 'seconds'.
- `constexpr bool Crossed(float before, float after, float moment)` — Whether advancing from 'before' to 'after' crossed 'moment' (inclusive, once).
- `constexpr float CountDown(float value, float amount)` — Decreases 'value' by 'amount', stopping at 0.
- `inline float DecayFactor(float rate, float seconds)` — What remains of a value decaying at 'rate' per second after 'seconds'.
- `inline bool BlinkOff(float remaining, float threshold, float period)` — Blinks every 'period' during the last 'threshold' seconds of a duration; true in the dim half.
